records.text: An unnamed authority said Corey Comperatore's widow and family were dissatisfied with the Butler investigation, the answers about his death, and the lack of Secret Service job losses.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 5NQyGuRYbU8)

appearances.snippet: I have it on authority the widow of Corey Comperatore and the family of Corey Comperatore is not like Trump (Donald Trump). They are not satisfied with the investigation. They are not happy with the fact that Secret Service agents never lost their jobs. ... They are not satisfied with the answers that they are receiving about how Corey Comperatore was killed. Imagine that.

verification.notes: Interviews with Corey Comperatore’s widow and family members document dissatisfaction with the investigation, unanswered questions, and criticism that suspensions without firings were insufficient.

sources.title: Secret Service has blood on their hands after Trump rally shooting, family says
sources.relevance: Documents Comperatore family dissatisfaction and criticism of the limited Secret Service discipline.
